_doc: Error code registry (C681, design/33). retryable: may be tried again later; exit: the process exit code a command reports for it (30 data not there yet, 75 source unavailable, 40 final, 64 configuration, 20 satisfied). 'pending' lists codes already in use as string literals that have not been classified yet; each needs a decision before the expiry.

ALREADY_SATISFIED.meaning: nothing to do: the result already exists (a skip, not a failure)

BAOSTOCK_CONNECTION_ERROR.meaning: Baostock connection failed or was cut

BAOSTOCK_GAP_UNRESOLVED.meaning: Baostock has not delivered the missing symbols yet; progress is kept, try again later

BAOSTOCK_LOCAL_GAP_WAIT.meaning: waiting for the local gap to close

COMMAND_ARGUMENT_ERROR.meaning: a command line argument is wrong

CONTRACT_ERROR.meaning: the function broke its reply contract

CONTRACT_INVALID.meaning: the request or reply is not valid under the contract

CONTRACT_VIOLATION.meaning: a (exit code, reply) pair outside the contract matrix

DDE_SYNC_INCOMPLETE_RETRYABLE.meaning: DDE sync finished part of the symbols

DDE_SYNC_RETRYABLE.meaning: DDE sync could not finish for a retryable reason

DETERMINISTIC_FAILURE.meaning: a failure that repeating will not change

FETCH_TIMEOUT.meaning: a fetch exceeded its time budget

INTERNAL_ERROR.meaning: the handler's catch-all for an exception nobody classified; not a contract exit code, never raised on purpose

KAIPAN_PLATE_MEMBERS_INCOMPLETE.meaning: Kaipan plate members came back incomplete

POSTCONDITION_FAILED.meaning: the function reported success but its declared postcondition does not hold

PREP_CRITICAL_MISSING.meaning: a critical pre-market step has no data and the prep run cannot make it appear (the fetch_item repair queue owns the repair); repeating the prep does not help

Q2_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: the q2 Redis snapshot cannot be read

RATE_LIMITED.meaning: the source or the local budget refuses another request for now

SOURCE_UNREADABLE.meaning: a source could not be read

STALL_NO_PROGRESS.meaning: the fill made no progress within its window; progress is kept

TD_REQUIRES_BAOSTOCK.meaning: TD daily bars only accept Baostock rows; the Baostock version is not there yet

TD_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED.meaning: TDengine query memory is exhausted (another process holds the pool, 0x073a); later is fine

TD_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: TDengine cannot be reached or refused the statement

TD_VERIFY_FAILED.meaning: the TD read-back differs from the catalog version: the day is not complete (TdVerifyError); repeating the write does not change what was written

TIER_DATE_MISMATCH.meaning: the data is for another day

TIER_NO_DATA.meaning: the tier has no data for the day and never will

TIER_PARTIAL.meaning: a tier delivered only part of the day; resume on the next attempt

UPSTREAM_NOT_READY.meaning: an input this function needs is not published yet (reason carries which, e.g. DAILY_KLINE_MISSING)

pending.reason: in use as literals before the registry existed; S2 classifies each with its producer
